Chapter 668 - 668 Encountering Zhao Ting; Victory!

Chapter 668 - 668 Encountering Zhao Ting; Victory!

668 Encountering Zhao Ting; Victory!

In the first 20 minutes of the mecha assessment, the battles were the most intense and chaotic.

Many people’s energy cores were shattered within these 20 minutes.

Tian Zhiwu was one of them.

Losing the energy core in two minutes had caused him to end up with zero points in the mecha assessment.

If he followed Lin Fan and the others, he might have been able to rank in the top few. How could he not regret it?

At this moment, a series of dull footsteps sounded not far away.

Zhao Ting, who had long bangs, walked over with a cold expression.

“In the afternoon, you’d better pray that you don’t meet me! Otherwise, I’ll teach you a lesson. Hmph!”

After saying that, he walked straight ahead.

Zhao Ting also knew that his mecha abilities were rather average.

However, he believed that he had extraordinary abilities!

Zhao Ting believed that as long as he met Lin Fan and the others, he would be able to defeat them and take revenge.

…

At noon…

Lin Fan, Xia Xue, Li Dongqiang, and Tian Zhiwu chose to eat at the cafeteria.

The cafeteria was much more crowded than usual.

There was an endless stream of students walking in.

Fortunately, Jiangbei University had made ample preparations in advance so that the students would not have to queue for too long or miss lunch.

After lunch, Li Dongqiang, Xia Xue, and Lin Fan took Tian Zhiwu to stroll around the campus.

After all, Tian Zhiwu came from Xia University. He was a guest and needed to be treated as such.

Tian Zhiwu pointed at the statue in the distance and said, “Is this the hero from a thousand years ago, Professor Lin Fan?”

“Yes,” Li Dongqiang said with certainty. “It’s said that Professor Lin used to think under that tree and solve difficult problems. Now, it has become a Path-Understanding Tree… And there, it’s said that someone broke his leg. In order to let the person stand up, Professor Lin invented advanced prosthetic limbs…”

Although Lin Fan had already heard all kinds of legends and stories about himself from Xia Xue, when he heard them again, he could not help but rub his nose awkwardly.

The few of them chatted as they strolled.

Time flowed like water, and in the blink of an eye, it was two o’clock.

At this moment, the students from Group 7 who were taking the assessment had returned to the plaza.

The originally flat plaza now had 50 more arenas.

It had to be said that the world a thousand years later was truly amazing.

With just a few hours of rest at noon, they could quickly build 50 sturdy large arenas.

Li Ke, who was standing at the front, glanced at the students and said, “The group arena is randomly divided into ten teams. The battle time is 30 minutes. As long as the opponent is knocked out of the arena or the opponent admits defeat, you’ll receive one point. At the same time, you’ll receive all the points your opponent has.

“Of course, the premise is that weapons are not allowed, and intentional killing is not allowed!

“Now, let’s announce the groups!”

As soon as Li Ke finished speaking, a huge 3D projection immediately appeared on the scene.

On it was the list of candidates in Group 7.

[Xia Xue: Team 30]

[Li Dongqiang: Team 33]

[Tian Zhiwu: Team 10]

[Lin Fan: Team 61]

…

“We’re not on the same team,” sighed Li Dongqiang.

Tian Zhiwu said, “You should be glad that we’re not in the same team. It’s ten people in a team. If we were all in the same team, each person would only get one point on average. In fact, when the game starts, the other 6 people might join forces to attack us. Then we’ll be in danger.”

“Huh? That seems to be the case.” Li Dongqiang said.

…

“Students in the first 50 teams, please enter the arenas!” Li Ke announced loudly.

When the students heard this, they all walked toward their own arena.

The other students swept their gazes across the arena one after another.

They discussed in low voices, wondering who would get a good result.

Meanwhile, Lin Fan focused his gaze on Ring 30.

…

At this moment, there were three women and seven men standing on Ring 30.

One of the women was Xia Xue.

The three women instinctively gathered together and looked warily at the seven guys in the distance.

The atmosphere was a little heavy.

At this moment, Li Ke, who was standing below the arena, said, “The group arena begins!”

The seven guys in Ring 30 did not choose to deal with the women first.

They attacked each other, and in a short while, four people were knocked off the stage.

The remaining three guys had wounds on their bodies.

They all felt that the other party was troublesome to deal with and did not attack easily.

Instead, their eyes fell on Xia Xue and the other women.

“What should we do?” the round-faced woman asked in a low voice. “It seems like they are going to deal with us.”

“We can’t just sit and wait for death!” said the oval-faced woman. “We have to take the initiative to attack!”

“Alright!”

Then, the three women charged at the three guys.

In many people’s minds, women were mostly weak.

However, those were just ordinary women.

Xia Xue and the others were not ordinary at all.

The oval-faced woman had a rapid ability, the round-faced woman had far more power than ordinary people, and Xia Xue’s speed and strength were not weak.

Three against three.

One side was full of energy, while the other was exhausted.

The ending was self-evident.

After some effort, the three guys were knocked out of the ring.

Seeing this, the three women all revealed a hint of joy.

At this moment, the oval-faced woman and the round-faced woman secretly looked at each other.

A fierce look appeared in their eyes.

Then, they suddenly attacked Xia Xue together.

They actually knew each other and had already made plans!

Seeing this…

Lin Fan, who was standing below the stage, raised his eyebrows and prepared to help.
